notes: Kernel has 5 inputs (a,b,c,akB,mkC at Input[tid*8+0..4]) and words 21,24,25,27,32 are gfx1013-only encodings (v_mad_f32, v_mac_f32, v_madak_f32, v_madmk_f32, v_mac_f32_e64) with no gfx103x encoding, so columns 4,5,6,7,9 cannot be measured on the gfx1036 oracle and are not covered by any part.
The fused columns 0..3 are asserted only if the host fuses (Check() detects it from column 0); on hardware they always fuse.
Split by word sub-range (not by column slice): each part replays a contiguous run of unmodified kernel words free of the gfx1013-only encodings.
Part 1: words 13..18 (v_fma_f32 v10; v_mov v11,v6 + v_fmac_f32 v11; v_fmaak_f32 v12, v4, v7, K) read v4..v7 = a,b,c,akB = the first 4 fields of the Rows struct.
